# North-star scorecard with thresholds (synthetic fixture)

Invented criteria for tests only. Thresholds sit in parentheses, as a hand-kept table often has them.

| # | Criterion | Status | Evidence (latest) | Weeks green |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Loop uptime (inputs fresh <24 h on >=95% days) | red | sentinel-evidence two inputs went quiet | 0 |
| 2 | Delivery (brief by 07:30 on 6 of 7 days) | amber | sentinel-evidence one brief came late | 0 |
| 3 | Review held (weekly, within 2 days (grace 1)) | red | sentinel-evidence review skipped | 0 |
| 4 | Capture triage (inbox <10) | green | sentinel-evidence inbox empty | 2 |
| 5 | (90% of 7 days) | amber | sentinel-evidence name is only a threshold | 0 |

Text after the table is ignored.
